login-form.name: Login Form
login-form.description: Authentication form for existing users to access their accounts. Includes validation and error handling via toast notifications.

signup-form.name: Signup Form
signup-form.description: Registration form for new users. Collects name, email, and password. Integrates with AuthContext for account creation.

compose-post-form.name: Post Composer Form
compose-post-form.description: Comprehensive form for creating social media posts. Supports multi-platform selection, content input, image uploads, and scheduling with date/time pickers.

compose-ai-assistant.name: AI Caption Assistant
compose-ai-assistant.description: AI-powered utility to generate post captions based on a topic and selected tone. Integrates directly into the composer's content field.

posts-management-list.name: Posts Management List
posts-management-list.description: A feed of posts with status filtering (Drafts, Scheduled, Published). Each post item allows for immediate publishing or deletion.

calendar-view-scheduler.name: Calendar View Scheduler
calendar-view-scheduler.description: Interactive calendar to view posts by date. Clicking a date displays the associated posts for that day, showing status and platforms.

accounts-integration-cards.name: Social Account Integrations
accounts-integration-cards.description: Management interface for linking and unlinking social media accounts (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn). Handles OAuth redirection and display of connected account handles.
